chapter: Opening, arrival in Los Angeles and the Quality Four
title: Leaving to form the Quality Four at the Hummingbird cafe
summary: He left the Black and Tan in 1923 to take the Quality Four into the Hummingbird on 12th Street; members are named and Thomas Valentine added to make the Quality Serenaders.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And according to this, you left the Black and Tan Orchestra in 1923?
Says, to take a quartet known as the
Quality Four into a local cafe.
What cafe would that have been?
Between Central and the next street over, I think it was Gladys Avenue. Yeah, it was on 12th.
On 12th Street, between Central and Gladys Avenue.
And it said, under Harvey (inaudible) this group recorded six titles in 1924. Is that right?
Do you have any of those records?
I think I do have, I'm not sure.
That would be interesting to hear, and to know that the names -- you know what lable they were on? The name of the company?
Uh-uh, I don't remember what label it was on.
And what was -- who were the members of the quartet, Harvey Brooks and you and who else?
Leon Hærriford, yeah. Got to get him in there somewhere.
That's great. What were the rest of his names?
Another Henry Allen. And then, you added Thomas Valentine on banjo?
Is that right? So it must have been -- the Quality Serenaders must have been around '24, '25.
